name: xTool D1 Pro 20W
tagline: 20W balanced module: xTool's most popular D1 Pro head
tldr: The 20W D1 Pro module is xTool's most popular open-frame head: mixed engraving and light cutting on the large D1 bed. Verify optical power on the listing; swap to 40W later if cut jobs dominate.

priceRange.note: 20W optical module: verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cannot: Clear acrylic cutting (diode light passes through)

pros: Everyday engrave and light cut mix: typical 8 mm basswood in several passes
Swappable head on the same chassis: upgrade power without replacing the whole machine
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Software on the profile: trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W SKU on xTool D1 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other modules via the chips before buying.
proTips: Use air assist for cuts, lower scan speed for photo engraving. Multiple passes at moderate speed beat one aggressive pass. Check the flagship tier’s cut benchmark if you quote production times to customers.
mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic

moduleSystem.headline: Swappable diode modules on D1 Pro frame
moduleSystem.description: xTool D1 Pro uses plug-in diode modules (5W–40W depending on era and listing). Buy the module power you need: same rail and software as other D1 Pro heads.

editorialDepth.advantages: The 20W diode module balances engraving and light cutting on xTool D1 Pro: the most versatile SKU before stepping up to a stronger head.
editorialDepth.limitations: If thick cutting dominates your week, compare 40W. Verify which module is in the box: same chassis, different heads.
